note: Test-id ledger for the engine lineup fix (owner ruling 2026-10-15, option 1: the engine refuses core.lineup.* for a sport that declares no lineupPolicy - boardgame, carrom, generic - raising their fold major to 2; the golden floor owes them no lineup or squads tokens and their withdrawal stream is re-recorded without lineup events), built against base c781d9c60 (origin/main). Ids are relative to the engine collection ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --ledger this-file. SCOPE: collected over the seven engine test files this branch changes (src/core/errors.test.ts, lineup-support.test.ts, lineup.events.test.ts, src/testkit/golden-floor.test.ts, golden-floor-streams.test.ts, golden-floor-overlay.test.ts, golden-overlay.test.ts), each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f>` from the engine directory, DATABASE_URL empty: 212 ids before, 226 after (6 retitled, 14 added, none retired). Every other engine test file is untouched, so its ids cannot move. The apps/web and tools/matrix tests this branch adds or edits (http.test.ts, append-event.test.ts, engine-http.ts) are outside the engine collection root and are not collected.
